source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 13 (PDF 4-17), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 (Thermal Physics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Thermal physics deals with the relationship between:
(Thermal physics kin cheezon ke darmiyan taalluq se bahas karti hai?)

options.text: heat, work, temperature aur energy ki doosri shaklein

blocks.explanation: Thermal physics heat, work, temperature aur energy ki doosri shaklon ke taalluq se bahas karti hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: deals with the relationship between heat, work, temperature, and other forms of energy

blocks.prompt:
2 A large system containing many atoms or molecules is called a:
(Aisa bara system jis mein bohat se atoms ya molecules hon, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se atoms/molecules wala system macroscopic (bara paimane ka) system kehlata hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: A large system containing many atoms or molecules is called a macroscopic system

blocks.prompt:
3 A system consisting of a single atom or molecule is called a:
(Aisa system jo sirf aik atom ya molecule par mushtamil ho, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik atom ya molecule wala system microscopic system kehlata hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: a system consisting of a single atom or molecule is called a microscopic system

blocks.prompt:
4 Which pair consists of properties of a macroscopic system?
(Kaun sa jora macroscopic system ki properties (khasoosiyat) ka hai?)

options.text: Aik molecule ki kinetic energy aur momentum
Aik electron ka charge aur spin
Aik atom ka mass aur speed

blocks.explanation: Temperature aur pressure poore (macroscopic) system ki thermal properties hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Macroscopic systems have properties such as temperature and pressure

blocks.prompt:
5 Kinetic energy and momentum are properties of a:
(Kinetic energy aur momentum kis qisam ke system ki properties hain?)
blocks.explanation: Microscopic system (aik atom/molecule) ki properties kinetic energy aur momentum hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Microscopic systems have properties such as kinetic energy and momentum

blocks.prompt:
6 In thermal physics, the number of particles dealt with is of the order of:
(Thermal physics mein zarraat ki tadaad kis darje (order) ki hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermal physics mein zarraat ki tadaad Avogadro's number ke darje ki hoti hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: we deal with large number of particles of the order of Avogadro's number

blocks.prompt:
7 The ideas of thermal physics can be extended to:
(Thermal physics ke tasawwurat ko kis tak phailaya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: sirf lenses mein roshni ki shuaaein
metals mein electrons ki harkat aur neutron stars mein neutrons

blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq thermal physics ko metals mein electrons ki harkat aur neutron stars ke neutrons tak phailaya ja sakta hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: We can extend it to the electron motion in metals and neutrons in neutron stars.

blocks.prompt:
8 Which of the following is listed as an application of the kinetic theory of gases in daily life?
(In mein se kaun si cheez kinetic theory of gases ki rozmarra application ke taur par di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Automobile engines, turbines, pumps, air conditioners aur khurak ki tayyari is ki applications hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: automobile engines, turbines, pumps, air conditioners

blocks.prompt:
9 To study thermal physics, knowledge of which two areas is needed?
(Thermal physics parhne ke liye kin do shobon ka ilm zaroori hai?)

options.text: Statistical mechanics aur kinetic theory of gases

blocks.explanation: Thermal physics mein statistical mechanics aur kinetic theory of gases shamil hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: includes the knowledge of statistical mechanics, and kinetic theory of gases

blocks.prompt:
10 Brownian motion is the:
(Brownian motion kya hai?)

options.text: fluid mein lataktay chhote zarraat ki be-tarteeb harkat, fluid ke molecules ki takkar se
pipe mein fluid ki yaksaan harkat
gravity ke tehat aazadana girte jism ki harkat
metal rod mein heat ka mustaqil bahao

blocks.explanation: Brownian motion fluid (maa'e) mein lataktay chhote zarraat ki be-tarteeb harkat hai jo fluid ke molecules ki takkar se hoti hai (13.1).

book_ref.quote: Brownian motion is the random motion of small particles suspended in a fluid

blocks.prompt:
11 Robert Brown, who first observed the random motion of pollen particles, was a:
(Robert Brown, jis ne pehli baar pollen zarraat ki be-tarteeb harkat dekhi, kaun tha?)
blocks.explanation: Robert Brown aik botanist (nabatat ka maahir) tha jis ne microscope se pollen zarraat dekhe (13.1).

book_ref.quote: Robert Brown, a botanist observed under microscope

blocks.prompt:
12 In which year did Robert Brown make his observation of pollen particles moving randomly in a liquid?
(Robert Brown ne liquid mein pollen zarraat ki be-tarteeb harkat kis saal dekhi?)
blocks.explanation: Brown ne 1827 mein mushahida kiya (13.1, book correction; kitab mein 1927 chhapa hai).

book_ref.quote: Robert Brown made his observation in 1827

blocks.prompt:
13 When gas molecules collide with each other, the collision transfers or exchanges:
(Jab gas molecules aapas mein takrate hain to takkar kya muntaqil (transfer) karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Takkar molecules ke darmiyan momentum aur energy ka tabadla karti hai (13.1).

book_ref.quote: collision transfers or exchanges the momentum and energy between the molecules

blocks.prompt:
14 A molecule that keeps on colliding with other molecules follows a:
(Jo molecule baar baar doosre molecules se takrata rahe, woh kaisi harkat karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baar baar takkar se molecule be-tarteeb ya zig-zag raasta ikhtiyar karta hai (13.1).

book_ref.quote: the colliding molecule follows a random or zig-zag motion

blocks.prompt:
15 In Brownian motion, which particles obtain greater speeds from collisions?
(Brownian motion mein kaun se zarraat takkar se zyada speed haasil karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Halke (chhote) zarraat takkar se zyada speed haasil karte hain (13.1).

book_ref.quote: Lighter particles obtain greater speeds from collisions

blocks.prompt:
16 Brownian movement is faster in a fluid of:
(Brownian movement kis qisam ke fluid mein tez hoti hai?)

options.text: zyada density magar molecular harkat nahi

blocks.explanation: Zarraat ki speed viscosity (gaarha-pan) ke ulat mutanasib hai; kam viscosity par Brownian movement tez hoti hai (13.1).

book_ref.quote: Low viscosity of the fluid results in the faster Brownian movement.

blocks.prompt:
17 Viscosity describes the magnitude of the:
(Viscosity kis cheez ki miqdaar bayan karti hai?)

options.text: aik mole mein molecules ki tadaad
fluid ke andar ki ragar (internal friction)

blocks.explanation: Viscosity fluid ke andar ki ragar (internal friction) ki miqdaar hai, yani bahao ki mazahmat (13.1).

book_ref.quote: Viscosity describes the magnitude of the internal friction in a fluid.

blocks.prompt:
18 Who explained the movement of pollen in a liquid in 1905?
(1905 mein liquid mein pollen ki harkat ki wazahat kis ne ki?)
blocks.explanation: Einstein ne 1905 mein wazahat ki; Perrin ne 1908 mein tajurbe se tasdeeq ki (13.1).

book_ref.quote: Albert Einstein explained the pollen movement in a liquid

blocks.prompt:
19 J Perrin, who experimentally verified Einstein's explanation of Brownian motion, received the Nobel Prize in physics in:
(J Perrin, jis ne Brownian motion ki Einstein wali wazahat ki tajurbati tasdeeq ki, ko physics ka Nobel Prize kis saal mila?)
blocks.explanation: Perrin ne 1908 mein tasdeeq ki aur 1926 mein Nobel Prize mila (13.1).

book_ref.quote: In 1908, a French physicist J Perrin experimentally verified

blocks.prompt:
20 Brownian motion represents one of the simple models of:
(Brownian motion kis cheez ka aik saada model hai?)
blocks.explanation: Brownian motion be-tarteebi (randomness) aur afra-tafri ko bayan karti hai (13.1).

book_ref.quote: it represents one of the simple models of randomness

blocks.prompt:
21 According to the kinetic theory, gas pressure arises due to:
(Kinetic theory ke mutabiq gas ka pressure kis wajah se paida hota hai?)

options.text: deewaron par zarraat ka ruka rehna
zarraat ka aapas mein aur bartan ki deewaron se takrana

blocks.explanation: Gas ka pressure zarraat ke aapas mein aur bartan ki deewaron se takrane se paida hota hai (13.2).

book_ref.quote: the gas pressure arises due to particles colliding with each other and the walls of the container

blocks.prompt:
22 Which of these is a transport property described by the kinetic theory of gases?
(In mein se kaun si transport property kinetic theory of gases bayan karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Viscosity, thermal conductivity aur diffusivity transport properties hain (13.2).

book_ref.quote: transport properties such as viscosity and thermal conductivity and diffusivity

blocks.prompt:
23 The kinetic molecular theory, as given in the chapter, applies to:
(Chapter ke mutabiq kinetic molecular theory kis par laagu hoti hai?)

options.text: sirf bohat zyada pressure wali real gases

blocks.explanation: Kinetic molecular theory ideal gases par laagu hoti hai (13.2).

book_ref.quote: The kinetic molecular theory applies to the ideal gases

blocks.prompt:
24 In the kinetic theory, gas particles are assumed to be:
(Kinetic theory mein gas zarraat ke baare mein kya farz kiya jata hai?)

options.text: bare zarraat jo aik doosre ko chhoo rahe hain
nanhay gol zarraat jo apne size ke muqable mein door door hain

blocks.explanation: Gas bohat se nanhay gol zarraat par mushtamil hai jo apne size ke muqable mein aik doosre se door hain (13.2).

book_ref.quote: far apart from one another compared to their sizes

blocks.prompt:
25 The motion of gas particles according to the kinetic theory is:
(Kinetic theory ke mutabiq gas zarraat ki harkat kaisi hai?)

options.text: aahista aur sirf aik axis par
musalsal, tez aur be-tarteeb simton mein
jame hue points ke gird dauri
garam karne tak koi harkat nahi

blocks.explanation: Gas zarraat musalsal, tez aur be-tarteeb simton mein harkat mein hain (13.2).

book_ref.quote: Gas particles are in constant rapid motion in random directions.

blocks.prompt:
26 Collisions between gas particles and the container walls are assumed to be:
(Gas zarraat aur bartan ki deewaron ki takkar ko kaisa farz kiya jata hai?)

options.text: heat ke nuqsaan ke saath kuch inelastic

blocks.explanation: Yeh takkarein bilkul elastic (lachakdar) hain, kinetic energy zaya nahi hoti (13.2).

book_ref.quote: Collisions between gas particles and the container walls are perfectly elastic collisions.

blocks.prompt:
27 Between collisions, the forces between gas particles of an ideal gas are:
(Takkaron ke darmiyan ideal gas ke zarraat mein forces kaisi hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Takkar se pehle zarraat ke darmiyan na kashish hai na dafa (13.2).

book_ref.quote: There are no forces of attraction or repulsion between gas particles

blocks.prompt:
28 The average kinetic energy of gas particles depends upon the gas's:
(Gas zarraat ki average kinetic energy kis cheez par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas zarraat ki average kinetic energy gas ke temperature par munhasir hai (13.2).

book_ref.quote: The average kinetic energy of gas particles is dependent upon the temperature of the gas.

blocks.prompt:
29 The mean free path is the average distance a moving particle covers:
(Mean free path woh average faasla hai jo harkat karta zarra kab tak tay karta hai?)

options.text: aisi takkar se pehle jo us ki simt ya energy ko kaafi badal de
bartan ki do deewaron ke darmiyan

blocks.explanation: Mean free path: woh average faasla jo zarra aisi takkar se pehle tay kare jo us ki simt ya energy ko kaafi badal de (13.2).

book_ref.quote: The mean free path is average distance a moving particle covered

blocks.prompt:
30 Compared with the volume of the empty spaces in a gas, the volume of the gas particles themselves is:
(Gas mein khaali jagah ke muqable mein khud gas zarraat ka volume kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas zarraat ka volume khaali jagah ke muqable mein na-qabil-e-zikr hai (13.2).

book_ref.quote: Volume of the gas particles is negligible compared to the volume of the empty spaces.

blocks.text: 13.3 Pressure in a Gas and Derivation of PV = ⅓Nm<v²>

blocks.prompt:
31 The kinetic-theory equation for gas pressure relates pressure and volume to which microscopic properties of the molecules?
(Gas pressure ki kinetic-theory equation pressure aur volume ko molecules ki kin microscopic properties se jorti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh equation macroscopic P aur V ko molecules ke mass aur speed se jorti hai (13.3).

book_ref.quote: relates the macroscopic properties of a gas (pressure and volume) to the microscopic properties of its molecules (mass and speed)

blocks.prompt:
32 The pressure of a gas is the:
(Gas ka pressure kya hai?)

options.text: tamam molecules ki kul kinetic energy
fi unit volume gas ka mass
takkar se deewaron par fi unit area lagne wali force
aik mole mein molecules ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: Pressure deewaron par molecules ki takkar se lagne wali fi unit area force hai (13.3).

book_ref.quote: The pressure of a gas is defined as the force exerted per unit area of the container walls

blocks.prompt:
33 When the temperature of a gas in a fixed container is increased, its pressure:
(Band bartan mein gas ka temperature barhayein to pressure kya hota hai?)

options.text: barhta hai kyun ke molecules tez chal kar zyada takrate hain
ghatta hai kyun ke molecules aahista ho jate hain
wohi rehta hai kyun ke volume fixed hai

blocks.explanation: Zyada temperature se molecules tez chalte hain, zyada takkarein hoti hain aur pressure barhta hai (13.3).

book_ref.quote: leading to more collisions, and consequently, a higher pressure

blocks.prompt:
34 The general gas constant R is related to the Boltzmann constant k_B and Avogadro's number N_A by:
(General gas constant R ka Boltzmann constant k_B aur Avogadro number N_A se kya taalluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: R = N_A k_B, is liye PV = nRT ban jata hai PV = nN_Ak_BT (13.3).

book_ref.quote: R is general gas constant equals to N_A k_B

blocks.prompt:
35 The value and unit of the Boltzmann constant are:
(Boltzmann constant ki qeemat aur unit kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ is the Boltzmann constant

blocks.prompt:
36 Using n = N/N_A, the gas law PV = nRT can be written as:
(n = N/N_A istemal karte hue gas law PV = nRT ko kaise likha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: PV = nN_Ak_BT mein n = N/N_A rakhne se PV = Nk_BT, Eq. (13.2).

book_ref.quote: The number of moles in terms of number of particle N is defined as

blocks.prompt:
37 How many molecules are in 1.0 m³ of an ideal gas at a pressure of 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa and a temperature of 300 K? (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹)
(1.0 × 10⁵ Pa pressure aur 300 K par ideal gas ke 1.0 m³ mein kitne molecules hain? (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: The ideal gas obeys the gas law which would relate the gas temperature with other parameters

blocks.prompt:
38 A molecule of mass m moving with velocity vₓ strikes a wall elastically and rebounds. The change in its momentum is:
(Mass m ka molecule vₓ velocity se deewar se elastic takkar kha kar wapas aata hai. Momentum mein tabdeeli kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Δp = −mvₓ − (mvₓ) = −2mvₓ (13.3).

book_ref.quote: its momentum changes from mv to -mv

blocks.prompt:
39 A gas molecule of mass 5.0 × 10⁻²⁶ kg moving at 500 m s⁻¹ along the x-axis rebounds elastically from a wall. The magnitude of its change in momentum is:
(5.0 × 10⁻²⁶ kg mass ka molecule x-axis par 500 m s⁻¹ se deewar se elastic takkar kha kar laut'ta hai. Momentum ki tabdeeli ki miqdaar kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Consider a collision in which the molecule with velocity v strikes one face of the cube along x-axis.

blocks.prompt:
40 In a cube of side L, the distance a molecule travels between two consecutive collisions with the same wall is:
(L side wale cube mein aik hi deewar se do lagataar takkaron ke darmiyan molecule kitna faasla tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molecule saamne wali deewar tak ja kar wapas aata hai, faasla 2L; waqt 2L/vₓ (13.3).

book_ref.quote: The molecule travels a distance 2L between the consecutive collisions

blocks.prompt:
41 A molecule moves with vₓ = 400 m s⁻¹ in a cubical box of side 0.20 m. The time between its consecutive collisions with the same wall is:
(0.20 m side wale cube mein molecule vₓ = 400 m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. Aik hi deewar se lagataar takkaron ka darmiyani waqt kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Hence, time between two consecutive collisions with one side of the cube is:

blocks.prompt:
42 The average force exerted on a wall by one molecule of mass m moving with x-velocity vₓ in a cube of side L is:
(L side ke cube mein vₓ x-velocity wale m mass ke aik molecule ki deewar par average force kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = |Δp|/Δt = 2mvₓ/(2L/vₓ) = mvₓ²/L, Eq. (13.4).

book_ref.quote: This expression represents the force exerted on the container wall by one molecule in the x-direction.

blocks.prompt:
43 A molecule of mass 5.0 × 10⁻²⁶ kg moves with vₓ = 400 m s⁻¹ in a cubical box of side 0.10 m. The average force it exerts on one wall is:
(5.0 × 10⁻²⁶ kg ka molecule 0.10 m side ke cube mein vₓ = 400 m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. Aik deewar par average force kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The average force exerted by the wall of cube on the molecule can be found using Newton's second law of motion.

blocks.prompt:
44 The pressure exerted on a wall by one molecule in a cube of volume V = L³ is:
(V = L³ volume ke cube mein aik molecule ka deewar par pressure kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: P = F/L² = (mvₓ²/L)/L² = mvₓ²/V, Eq. (13.5).

book_ref.quote: This is the pressure exerted on container wall by one molecule.

blocks.prompt:
45 If a container holds N particles each of mass m, the total mass M of the gas is:
(Agar bartan mein N zarraat hon aur har aik ka mass m ho to gas ka kul mass M kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kul mass = zarraat ki tadaad × aik zarre ka mass, M = mN (13.3).

book_ref.quote: then total mass is the number of particles times mass of the particle

blocks.prompt:
46 The velocities are squared before averaging in the kinetic theory because:
(Kinetic theory mein average lene se pehle velocities ka square kyun kiya jata hai?)

options.text: vₓ aur −vₓ ka saada average sifar hota hai

blocks.explanation: Molecule vₓ se takrata aur −vₓ se lautta hai, saada average sifar aata hai; square karne se yeh masla khatam (13.3).

book_ref.quote: which would result in average velocity zero

blocks.prompt:
47 The root mean square (rms) velocity is:
(Root mean square (rms) velocity kya hai?)

options.text: velocities ke square roots ka average
velocities ke squares ke average ka square root
tamam velocities ka jor do par taqseem

blocks.explanation: rms velocity = √<v²>, yani squares ke average ka square root (13.3; Eq. 13.8 book correction).

book_ref.quote: it is known as the root mean square (rms) velocity

blocks.prompt:
48 Four molecules have speeds 1, 2, 3 and 4 m s⁻¹. Their rms speed is:
(Chaar molecules ki speeds 1, 2, 3 aur 4 m s⁻¹ hain. Un ki rms speed kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: If we take the square root of the average square of the velocities

blocks.prompt:
49 For molecules moving randomly with the same average speed in all three directions, <v²> is equal to:
(Teeno simton mein yaksaan average speed se be-tarteeb chalte molecules ke liye <v²> kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: have the same average speed in all three directions

blocks.prompt:
50 For a gas, <v²> = 2.7 × 10⁵ m² s⁻². The value of <vₓ²> is:
(Aik gas ke liye <v²> = 2.7 × 10⁵ m² s⁻². <vₓ²> kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Since the molecules are moving randomly in all directions

blocks.prompt:
51 The kinetic-theory expression for an ideal gas of N molecules each of mass m in volume V is:
(V volume mein m mass ke N molecules wali ideal gas ke liye kinetic-theory ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: PV = ⅓Nm<v²>, Eq. (13.13).

book_ref.quote: This is the pressure of the gas molecules on the wall.

blocks.prompt:
52 In terms of density ρ, the pressure of a gas is:
(Density ρ ki shakal mein gas ka pressure kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: ρ = mN/V se P = ⅓ρ<v²> (13.3; chhapa hua PV = ⅓ρ<v²> ghalat hai).

book_ref.quote: This is the pressure of the gas which depends on the density and root mean square of velocity.

blocks.prompt:
53 An ideal gas has a density of 2.0 kg m⁻³ at a pressure of 1.5 × 10⁵ Pa. The rms speed of its molecules is:
(Aik ideal gas ki density 2.0 kg m⁻³ aur pressure 1.5 × 10⁵ Pa hai. Molecules ki rms speed kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Pressure is defined as; P = ⅓ρ<v²>

blocks.prompt:
54 A gas of density 1.2 kg m⁻³ has an rms molecular speed of 500 m s⁻¹. Its pressure is:
(1.2 kg m⁻³ density wali gas ki rms speed 500 m s⁻¹ hai. Us ka pressure kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: To find the rms value, take the square root of the mean-square-speed

blocks.prompt:
55 If the rms speed of the molecules of a gas is doubled while its density stays the same, its pressure becomes:
(Agar density wohi rahe aur gas molecules ki rms speed dugni ho jaye to pressure kitna ho jayega?)
blocks.explanation: P = ⅓ρvᵣₘₛ², is liye vᵣₘₛ dugni karne se P chaar guna (13.3).

blocks.prompt:
56 In P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T>, the symbol N₀ stands for:
(P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T> mein N₀ kya hai?)

options.text: N/V, fi unit volume molecules ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: P = (2/3)(N/V)<½mv²> mein N/V = N₀, yani fi unit volume molecules ki tadaad (13.3).

book_ref.quote: Rearranging the pressure, Eq. (13.13) for P, and substituting the density

blocks.prompt:
57 A gas has 2.5 × 10²⁵ molecules per m³, each with average translational kinetic energy 6.0 × 10⁻²¹ J. The gas pressure is:
(Aik gas mein fi m³ 2.5 × 10²⁵ molecules hain, har aik ki average translational K.E. 6.0 × 10⁻²¹ J hai. Gas ka pressure kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The pressure in terms of density can be written as:

blocks.prompt:
58 The mass of one molecule of a gas of molecular mass 40 u is: (1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg)
(40 u molecular mass wali gas ke aik molecule ka mass kitna hai? (1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg))

59 Taking the mass of a nitrogen molecule as 4.6 × 10⁻²⁶ kg, its rms speed at 400 K is: (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹)
(Nitrogen molecule ka mass 4.6 × 10⁻²⁶ kg le kar 400 K par us ki rms speed kitni hai? (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: Mass of Nitrogen N₂ = 28 × 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 4.6 × 10⁻²⁶ kg

blocks.prompt:
60 Compared with the speed of sound in air (about 340 m s⁻¹), the rms speed of air molecules at room temperature is:
(Hawa mein awaz ki speed (taqreeban 340 m s⁻¹) ke muqable mein kamre ke temperature par hawa ke molecules ki rms speed:)
blocks.explanation: rms speeds (O₂ ke liye taqreeban 481, N₂ ke liye 515 m s⁻¹) awaz ki speed se kahin zyada hain (13.3).

book_ref.quote: The speed of air molecules is much greater than the speed of sound

blocks.prompt:
61 When a popcorn kernel is heated, the moisture trapped inside it:
(Jab popcorn ka daana garam kiya jaye to us ke andar qaid nami (moisture) ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: bhaap ban kar andar ka pressure barhati hai
pressure badle baghair aahista nikal jati hai

blocks.explanation: Qaid nami bhaap ban jati hai; andar pressure barh kar chhilka phaar deta hai (Daily life examples).

book_ref.quote: the moisture trapped in popcorn kernel becomes steam

blocks.prompt:
62 When the pressure in a popcorn kernel ruptures its cover, it releases:
(Jab popcorn ke daane ka pressure chhilka phaarta hai to kya bahar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phatne par gelatinous starch bahar aata hai jo thanda ho kar sakht ho jata hai (Daily life examples).

book_ref.quote: it ruptures the corn cover releasing the gelatinous starch

blocks.prompt:
63 Pumping air into a car tyre raises the pressure inside it because:
(Gaari ke tyre mein hawa bharne se andar pressure kyun barhta hai?)

options.text: tyre ka volume sifar ho jata hai
mehdood volume mein zyada molecules deewaron se zyada baar takrate hain

blocks.explanation: Mehdood volume mein zyada molecules deewaron se zyada takrate hain, is liye pressure barhta hai (Daily life examples).

book_ref.quote: the number of air molecules increases which raises the air pressure inside the tyres

blocks.prompt:
64 What gives a car tyre its hardness so that it bears the car's weight?
(Gaari ke tyre ko sakhti kaun deta hai taa ke woh gaari ka wazan utha sake?)
blocks.explanation: Andar ki hawa ka pressure tyre ko sakhti deta hai (Daily life examples).

book_ref.quote: The pressure gives the tyre its hardness

blocks.text: 13.4 Average Translational Kinetic Energy of a Gas

blocks.prompt:
65 The Boltzmann constant is equal to:
(Boltzmann constant kis ke barabar hai?)

book_ref.quote: The gas constant R is related with Boltzmann constant and Avogadro number.

blocks.prompt:
